mods.description: This project fixes the issue causing players to stutter due to client interpolation changes made by Mojang.

releases.notes:
Client-side Fabric workaround for Minecraft 26.3 remote entity movement stuttering.

- Smooths short movement paths while preserving server-provided positions.
- Corrects interpolation clock initialization, advancement, reset and completion.
- Leaves local-authoritative timing and network packets unchanged.
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Java 25+. No Fabric API or server mod is required.

The release workflow builds and tests this tag's source, then attaches the compiled mod JAR, sources JAR and SHA-256 checksums. The installable file is `player-stutter-fix-1.0.0.jar`; the sources JAR is for developers.

Short remote updates gain some visual interpolation delay. Longer update gaps can still cause pauses. See the README for the investigation and testing limitations.
